title: DeepSeek v4 Worker Output Schema
description: Bounded output schema for DeepSeek v4 worker micro-tasks. One record per request, no markdown, JSON only.

task_id.description: Copied verbatim from the input task. Must match exactly.

loop.description: Copied verbatim from the input task. Must match exactly.

reason.description: Short explanation of the classification. Under 180 characters.

next_action.description: One concrete next action. Under 220 characters.

needs_human_review.description: Whether a human should review before the action is applied.
